title: China's Lenovo posts 43% jump in Q1 revenue, riding AI infrastructure boom
excerpt: China's Lenovo Group reported a 43% jump in quarterly revenue on Thursday, beating forecasts to drive shares up as much as 22%, as the world's largest comput...
content_html:
By Laurie Chen

BANGALORE/BEIJING, Aug 13 (Reuters) - China's Lenovo Group reported a 43% jump in quarterly revenue on Thursday, beating forecasts to drive shares up as much as 22%, as the world's largest computer maker rides an AI hardware boom and benefits ‌from a global memory chip shortage.

Lenovo's revenue rose to $26.94 billion in the three months ended June 30, beating analyst expectations of $22.3 ‌billion, as the consumer electronics hardware giant benefited from artificial intelligence-driven demand and solid PC sales.

It was the group's highest quarterly revenue growth in the last five years, as AI-related ​revenue grew 60% on the year to $9.3 billion, making up 35% of total revenue in its fiscal first quarter.

SUCCESSFULLY TACKLED SUPPLY SHORTAGES, COST INCREASES

"We accurately anticipated supply shortages and cost increases (of memory chips), and addressed it successfully," Chief Executive Yang Yuanqing told Reuters.

He attributed the success to the firm's scale, resilient global supply chains and diversified memory supply from China, South Korea and the United States.

"I'm very confident in sustaining this growth momentum and driving long ‌term profitability," he said, adding that Lenovo is on ⁠track to reach revenue of $100 billion this fiscal year.

The company swung to a net loss attributable to shareholders of $609 million from a profit of $505 million last year, compared to the average analyst estimate of $589 million profit, according to ⁠data compiled by LSEG.

The company said the loss was primarily due to a non-cash fair value loss of $1.7 billion arising from the revaluation of warrants issued in 2025.

Its AI server pipeline reached $54.0 billion, up 157% quarter-over-quarter, reflecting demand from hyperscalers, AI cloud and enterprise AI clients, it said in the earnings report.

"It's clear ​that ​we are becoming a global AI infrastructure leader as well," Yang said, adding that ​he believed Lenovo can maintain its AI-led growth momentum ‌this year.

Lenovo's shares hit an all-time high on Thursday before the results announcement, taking year-to-date gains to 225%.

COMPETITORS HAVE RAISED PRICES THIS YEAR

U.S. competitors Dell, Hewlett Packard and Super Micro have been some of Wall Street's best performers this year but have raised prices by 10% to 30% due to soaring costs of NAND and DRAM memory chips.

Lenovo's PC, tablet and smartphone division, which accounted for about 64% of total revenue, reported a 27% year-on-year increase in revenue during the period.

content_html_zh:
作者：劳里·陈

班加罗尔/北京，8 月 13 日（路透社）——中国联想集团周四公布季度收入增长 43%，超出预期，推动股价上涨 22%，这家全球最大的计算机制造商得益于人工智能硬件的繁荣，并受益于全球存储芯片短缺。

截至 6 月 30 日的三个月，联想的收入升至 269.4 亿美元，超出分析师预期的 223 亿美元，这家消费电子硬件巨头受益于人工智能驱动的需求和强劲的 PC 销售。

这是该集团过去五年来最高的季度收入增长，人工智能相关收入同比增长 60%，达到 93 亿美元，占第一财季总收入的 35%。

成功解决供应短缺和成本上升问题

首席执行官杨元庆对路透社表示：“我们准确预测了供应短缺和（存储芯片）成本上升的问题，并成功解决了这一问题。”

他将成功归功于公司的规模、富有弹性的全球供应链以及来自中国、韩国和美国的多元化内存供应。

他表示：“我对维持这种增长势头并推动长期盈利能力非常有信心。”他补充说，联想本财年的收入有望达到 1000 亿美元。

根据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 编制的数据，该公司去年的利润为 5.05 亿美元，但股东应占净亏损为 6.09 亿美元，而分析师平均预期利润为 5.89 亿美元。

该公司表示，亏损主要是由于2025年发行的认股权证重估造成17亿美元的非现金公允价值损失。

该公司在财报中表示，其人工智能服务器管道达到 540 亿美元，环比增长 157%，反映了超大规模企业、人工智能云和企业人工智能客户的需求。

杨说：“很明显，我们也正在成为全球人工智能基础设施的领导者。”他补充说，他相信联想今年能够保持人工智能主导的增长势头。

周四，在业绩公布前，联想股价创下历史新高，年初至今涨幅达 225%。

今年竞争对手已经提高了价格

美国竞争对手戴尔、惠普和超微是今年华尔街表现最好的公司之一，但由于 NAND 和 DRAM 内存芯片成本飙升，它们已将价格提高了 10% 至 30%。

占总营收约64%的联想个人电脑、平板电脑和智能手机部门，期内营收同比增长27%。
